_comment: Single source of truth for prosthetic-conscience's local tool dependencies. Consumed by the shared toolchain probe (tools/internal/toolchain), used by both the hook binaries and /prosthetic-conscience:doctor. See plans/claude-port-plan.md §3a'.

tools.name: git
tools.purpose: version control; the blackboard is git-tracked

tools.name: qlty
tools.purpose: format + lint quality gate (sc-quality-gate runs it)

tools.name: node
tools.purpose: JavaScript runtime — FEOV workflow simulator + cost-audit, npx-launched MCP servers (pdf-reader), and the npm-installed qmd

tools.name: qmd
tools.purpose: research-corpus recall index — the ONE installed qmd shared by the MCP server (read path) and sc-recall-index hook (write path), so index-schema skew is impossible; this install string is the version authority

tools.name: uv
tools.purpose: Python tool runner — uvx launches the arxiv-latex MCP server (FEOV document extraction)

_hook_binaries._comment: OUR compiled hooks, not external deps — one per directory under tools/cmd/. /prosthetic-conscience:doctor --fix fetches the CI-built release asset <name>_{goos}_{goarch}{exe} (SHA256-verified) into bin/, falling back to go build only as a dev convenience. hooks.json invokes ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/<name>.

binaries.name: sc-secrets-gate
binaries.purpose: deny outbound payloads matching secret patterns

binaries.name: sc-toolchain-nudge
binaries.purpose: one-line warning when a recommended tool is missing

binaries.name: sc-push-freeze-guard
binaries.purpose: warns on git push while a research run is live (.run-live marker) — the pinned-path freeze made unforgettable, never blocking

binaries.name: sc-recall-index
binaries.purpose: qmd FTS update on markdown writes — deterministic recall freshness; runs ONLY the doctor-installed qmd (no npx fallback — a second resolution path is a second version), silent no-op when absent
